title: Capital funds.
bodyText: Capital funds means the excess of the assets of an insurer over its liabilities. Capital stock, if any, shall not be deemed to be a liability for the purposes of this section.
bodyHtml: §431:3-102  Capital funds.  Capital funds means the excess of the assets of an insurer over its liabilities.  Capital stock, if any, shall not be deemed to be a liability for the purposes of this section. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
